full_judgment: 17. PW 5 Md Rafiqul Islam stated that he came to know the disappearance of victim at about 12-00 pm on 5-10-2014. He and others searched for her, but failed to trace her. On the following day, while he was going through the road and reached in front of the primary school, Sumon called him and made a disclosure that he along with Swapan had raped and killed the victim. At that time, he thought it was a false statement. Afterwards, at about 12-00 pm he and Swapan were returning from market and when reached on the bank of government pond, they sat on a bench. Sumon also came there. Then Swapan asked him to go for a search of the victim at the garden. He was not ready for that and needed to change his trousers. So, he told them to go for the search. Accordingly, they went inside the garden. At that time his cousin Billal came there. While they were talking, Ashraf Ali was seen entering into the garden. Bellal having seen him entering into the garden also went inside the garden. At that point of time, Sumon and Swapan ran out a short distance and stood beside the dead body of the victim. Thereafter, Swapan made a loud cry. Hearing his cry villagers rushed to the spot. Later, police came and took them to the police station. The .Superintendent of Police interrogated them. On interrogation, Sumon admitted the earlier disclosure of commission of the offence. He (PW5) was taken before the learned Magistrate where he made a statement under section 164 of the Code.
